referees.quote: Overall I find the study to be of high quality and that it is suitable for publication, subject to addressing some concerns below.

The paper is generally suitable for Nature Communications... These plots could be presented in the Supplementary Information section. With these or a comparable modification I will be happy to recommend the manuscript for publication
I therefore ask the authors to make significant changes to the manuscript so that the experimental rigor of their work becomes clear... I ask for measurements on different devices.

note: No transfer from another journal is indicated; Version 0 is the first round in this file. Reviewer #1's Version 0 remarks are blank in the main report section. Their first-round report appears as an attachment at the end of the file (page 13), and it is the basis for R1's recommendation. R1 asks questions, including whether the effect was seen in multiple devices, rather than demanding new data, so it is inferred as minor revision. R2 asks only for current-voltage curves to go in the Supplementary Information, so it is inferred as minor revision. R3 demands significant changes and measurements on additional devices, so it is inferred as major revision. No referee co-signed another's report.
